quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Alongside or opposite any highway excavation or obstruction when stopping, standing or parking would obstruct traffic.

activation.condition: Vehicle stops, stands or parks alongside or opposite a source-reviewed highway excavation or obstruction.

obligation.description: Do not stop, stand or park there when the activity would obstruct traffic unless an exact exception applies.

exceptions.source_clause: except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic

exceptions.description: Retain the applicable original legal authority.

exceptions.source_clause: the directions of a police officer
exceptions.description: Retain original officer direction and timing.
Retain original official device identity and indication.

timing.description: Observe the whole stopping, standing or parking interval with same-time traffic response.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: when stopping, standing or parking would obstruct traffic
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original same-time traffic movement and obstruction effects require independent review.
